execution_policy.workflow_children: Observe Controller-created child jobs; never relaunch them as parallel copies.
execution_policy.failure_branches: Untaken branches are not executed coverage; add explicit recovery cases.
execution_policy.readiness: Require expected non-local hosts and successful relevant tasks, not only job status.
execution_policy.cleanup: After consumers reach terminal states, attempt owned-resource cleanup even on failure.
execution_policy.unknown_live_templates: Report unmapped; do not guess prerequisites or launch automatically.
execution_policy.inputs: Resolve surveys, template vars, fixture bindings, and credentials before launching.

ee_under_test.image_reference: Resolve a published immutable digest built from the exact revision under test.
ee_under_test.definition: Select execution_environments/apd-ee-<AAP major/minor>.yml after Controller version discovery.
ee_under_test.reconciliation: Before first setup, after every setup/seed operation, and before every scenario launch.
ee_under_test.verify_each_execution: Record expected image digest and observed job EE; mismatches fail provenance.
ee_under_test.missing_digest_evidence: Mark EE provenance unverified; never claim verified candidate coverage.
ee_under_test.supporting_updates: Explicitly bind eligible project/inventory updates and report any platform-required exceptions.
ee_under_test.restore_configuration: Capture and restore prior project, organization, template and EE settings in finalizers.
ee_under_test.specialized_policy: Resolve these images to declared digests and report their jobs separately from candidate-EE coverage.

gates.controller: Authenticated Controller API, correct organization/project revision, and no active fixture consumers.
gates.aws: Configured AWS and APD Machine credentials; SSH private key and Windows password; region and owner.
gates.owned_fixtures: Identify resources created by this run; fixed-name existing resources need explicit reuse policy.
gates.ee: Register and bind candidate digest, verify specialized image map, and record core/collections/tools before launching.
gates.rhsm: Valid RHSM Registration org ID and activation key; repository access on workers and report server.
gates.linux_inputs: Existing sudo/key user, public key, benign shell command, service and application package.
gates.insights: Insights credential, registration tags/org, inventory access, and externally assigned compliance profile.
gates.patch_inputs: Applicable RHEL advisories and removable Windows KBs, with evidence of installable updates.
gates.snapshots: Completed run-owned snapshots and exact instance/volume mapping; verified restore targets.
gates.hardening_fixtures: Separate disposable hosts and a fresh baseline for each incompatible hardening profile.
gates.eda: Synced EDA project, decision environment, running activation, and reachable Kafka listener.
gates.network: Rebuilt network EE, image access, AWS capacity, device/SCP credentials, and fresh owned hypervisor.
gates.ios_image: SCP server has selected licensed IOS image and matching checksum; device has staging space.
gates.panos: Marketplace subscription, firewall and bastion credentials, and run-owned PAN-OS resources.
gates.cluster: Existing reachable cluster and scoped credentials; independent of the excluded OpenShift category.
gates.ao: AO EE, AAP credential, LiteMaaS integration, and owned AO namespace with captured prior state.
gates.rosa: Working ROSA EE/token, STS permissions, quota, unique cluster name, and lifecycle timeout budget.
gates.satellite: Reachable configured Satellite, synced content, credentials, RHEL8 image and lifecycle policies.
gates.approval: Explicit test policy for approving this run's Satellite workflow approval nodes.
gates.feedback_sink: Configured test mailbox/sink for feedback and telemetry; no unintended external recipients.
gates.cleanup_adapters: Implement and validate cleanup for resources without APD cleanup templates before execution.
